notes.title: v 0.0.3 Small Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39160308/5e8052dab1fa868350e93aac109b02f42251a080.png[/img]

[h1]Introducing Minerals.[/h1]

Players now able to collect some common , rare and epic minerals from random locations on world. 

* Iron
* Gold
* Diamond
* Tantalum
* Astatine
* Antimatter

With future updates player will use those minerals at repairing wonders , upgrading technologies and some other features.
